candidates.review_note: A spanning tree supplies LCA path upper bounds. Every shorter route uses a non-tree edge and hence contains a selected endpoint of one of at most21 extra edges. Run Dijkstra once per selected endpoint and minimize dist(s,u)+dist(s,v) for each query. Store only one distance vector at a time to avoid O(42n) Python integer memory.

Handle collinear generators by primitive-direction gcd. Otherwise perform exact two-dimensional Gauss lattice reduction with integer dot products. Reduced basis satisfies |projection|<=1/2 and perpendicular height>=sqrt(3)/2 times shortest length. Any L1 improvement over u has Euclidean norm<=sqrt(2)*|u|, bounding both integer coefficients within2; enumerate that finite neighborhood exactly.

Group row strings by their count vector; group weight is its multinomial multiplicity. Beautiful formations are ordered selections of N distinct groups weighted by these multiplicities, N! times an elementary symmetric polynomial. Compute power sums by coefficient extraction of (sum x^c/(c!)^j)^K times(M!)^j, then Newton identities. This preserves row order and within-row permutations.

DP over exact number of nonempty boxes. For each right endpoint, the arriving type increases distinct-count scores only for last-cut positions after its previous occurrence. A lazy range-add/max segment tree stores previous-layer score plus current distinct count, and prefix query excludes empty last boxes. O(K*n*log n), no greedy independent packing.

Treat2/5 and6/9 as shared physical tile classes. Scan the first differing digit from right to left, holding exact prefix fixed and restoring suffix tile counts. At the first feasible pivot choose smallest larger displayed digit, then fill suffix with sorted minimal displays of remaining classes. Fixed digit count and one decimal position preserved; increased first digit cannot introduce leading zero.

Polycarp wins if his Manhattan arrival time is no later than Vasiliy Chebyshev arrival time, including first-move tie. He also wins when coordinatewise southwest, using blocking to prevent the diagonal player passing him. Otherwise Vasiliy has both a strict timing advantage and a free axis to bypass. Both nonnegative boundaries and skip moves are included in independent finite-state game checks.

Burnside average grouped by permutation cycle partitions. One length-l cycle yields floor(l/2) internal edge orbits; two cycles yield gcd(lengths) cross-edge orbits. A partition contributes m^orbits divided by product(length^count*count!). Recursion updates both orbit count and reciprocal multiplicity, valid since prime modulus exceeds n. Colors remain labeled; vertices are quotiented.

Factor each positive integer exactly, counting prime exponents by parity rather than counting multiplicities. Remaining prime after trial division contributes one odd exponent; number1 has no exponents and is Ordinary. Strictly more even exponents is required, ties remain Ordinary. No unstated bounded-primality shortcut.
